tldr: Lilith in Leo: the wound around being seen; pride inflated to cover shame.
body: With Lilith in Leo, rejection strikes at pride. The response is an enlarged self-image defended at all costs: needing the spotlight, dramatic displays when ignored, attention pursued by any means because being unseen feels like being erased.
gift: Magnetism, confidence, and real performing power when worth stops depending on applause.
challenge: Arrogance out of step with reality, manipulation that makes everything about them, drama as a response to shame.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
